caption: The drawing depicts a section of ornate wrought iron fence positioned vertically in the center of the image. The fence consists of two cylindrical, decorative vertical posts on either side, topped with pointed finials. Between these posts is a rectangular panel of ironwork featuring symmetrical, repeating floral and fleur-de-lis patterns with pointed elements extending upwards. The drawing is rendered in black and white with shades of gray, using fine lines and shading for detail and depth, and is centered on a plain, lightly textured off-white background. There is a small handwritten signature or note in the lower right corner of the fence panel.
title: Fencing
